theorems.name: Submission.idtp_cse_etp_rescaled_limit_mem
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (S : Set (Euclid P)) (a w : Euclid P) (m : ℝ) (lams : ℕ → ℝ) (ws : ℕ → Euclid P), IsClosed S → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μ K ≠ ∞) → (∀ j, 0 < lams j) → Tendsto ws atTop (𝓝 w) → (∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → Tendsto (fun j => (lams j)⁻¹ ^ 2 * ∫ x, g (dilation a (lams j) x) ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 (m * ∫ x in S, g x ∂μHE[2]))) → (∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → ∀ᶠ j in atTop, unitBallVolume 2 * ENNReal.ofReal ((lams j * r) ^ 2) ≤ μ (ball (a + lams j • ws j) (lams j * r))) → w ∈ S
